svg.text: Two ways in: a GitHub event, or an hourly scan of requirements issues -> GitHub Actions -> Copilot -> pull request -> CI + Copilot review -> merge
GITHUB ACTIONS · ai-factory reusable workflows, pinned @v1.1
creates task sub-issues + blocked-by links, at most 3 in progress
CI fails: self-heal sends the log to @copilot
a merged PR closes its task sub-issue; the next scan releases the tasks whose blockers are closed
